Select IC50 activity rows for JAK2 with provenance and structures. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join docs on activities.doc_id. Join compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target_dictionary.pref_name = 'JAK2' and activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
